reviews.t: It works perfectly on snow white hair.
reviews.x: This glaze has been wonderful.  It was hard to find in my area, so Amazon was an easy answer.  It is a rinse and must be rinsed off, but it makes you shine beautifully.  I have white hair and John Frieda's Color Glaze keeps it bright and never any problems with yellowness.

Some background: I'm pushing 60 HARD and I've colored my hair since I was a teenager. In the past few years I've cautioned hair stylists that my hair is "aging" and I don't want to exacerbate the issue.  I don't like the cotton candy look in the least.  Youve seen it and know what I mean, I'm sure. I've been using the Frieda Glaze for a few months and I've noticed AMAZING results!  My hair looks and feels healthy and "young" with bounce and shine!  You need this in your life girl

No lingering weird smells, no slimy feel, no color transfer as this is a clear glaze, and no damage to colored hair. love this product!  I read a review of it on Paula's Choice, and have used it now for about a year on my color-treated hair.  Makes my humidity-affected hair sleek and smooth.  I use a quarter-sized amount in the shower after briefly rinsing out my conditioner, leaving it in for a few minutes while I wash up.  A brief rinse (5-10 seconds) and I'm outta there!

I ordered this thinking it was going to be a glaze that's applied similarly to an at home hair dye, but I was happily suprised to find that it's applied just like shampoo.  I use it in the shower about 3 times a week and it makes my hair shiny and glossy without making it greasy and stringy.  I'm very glad I got the 2 pack.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the product leaves hair shiny, soft, and frizz-free, especially in humid conditions.
Several reviewers praise it for color-treated, graying, or white hair, keeping it bright and smooth.
A few reviewers report negative results, saying it dried out their hair and added no shine or conditioning.
Some reviewers complain about the reformulated version, citing a strong chemical scent and drier-feeling hair.
A few reviewers mention issues with the supplier or product itself, including a missing replacement shipment and glitter in the formula.
